limitations: Generated PostgreSQL fixture, four assignments/post, one process per detector and a 40/sec writer probe; not full live ingestion, raw/checkpoint fsync or six-hour soak. The concurrent probe changes one candidate, so steady-state is nearly unchanged. Snapshot scores converge on a later run for concurrent events. Baseline and optimized stages share data; probe posts accumulate. Wall times include detector work, not worker startup.
implementation_stage: Intermediate optimization with bounded advisory-lock publication; final implementation also removes that advisory lock from metric publication/pruning. Final large rerun was interrupted during severe host contention; these figures are retained as staged measurements, not final lock-refinement timings.
